traits.name: Dual Mind
traits.description: You have Advantage on all Wisdom saving throws.

traits.name: Mental Discipline
traits.description: You resist Psychic damage.

traits.name: Mind Link
traits.description: You can speak telepathically to a creature you can see within 10 feet times your level, and can let it answer you telepathically for a short time.

traits.name: Severed from Dreams
traits.description: You sleep but don't dream, so spells and effects that work through dreams (such as Dream) can't affect you.

notes: Legacy species for use with 2024 rules: ignore its old fixed ability score increases and language list; ability scores come from your background and you know Common plus two languages.

name: Leonin

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet as though it were bright light, and in darkness within that range as though it were dim light (shades of gray only).

traits.name: Claws
traits.description: Your Unarmed Strikes can deal 1d4 + Strength modifier Slashing damage.

traits.name: Hunter's Instincts
traits.description: You gain proficiency in one skill from the list.

traits.name: Daunting Roar
traits.description: As a Bonus Action you roar; creatures of your choice within 10 feet that hear it must pass a Wisdom save (DC 8 + PB + Con mod) or be Frightened of you until the end of your next turn. Once per Short or Long Rest.

notes: Legacy species for use with 2024 rules: ignore its old fixed ability score increases and language list; ability scores come from your background and you know Common plus two languages.
